note: R3.0C C7_UI state. Adds the Comparison Workspace UI: three new authorized renderer/js paths (r3-0c-comparison-orchestrator.js, r3-0c-comparison-viewmodel.js, i18n-comparisons.js) all bound to the new ui_present capability. The orchestrator owns request-token issuance + framing emission (composes C5 delta-metrics + C6 export); the viewmodel is the pure state machine consuming orchestrator output, implementing the 7 transition triggers + stale-token drop per contracts/r3.0c/viewmodel-state-transition-contract.js. The framing-source contract (contracts/r3.0c/framing-i18n-key-registry.js) is enabled: every framing entry the orchestrator emits is validated against a closed allowlist of i18nKeys before reaching the viewmodel; the viewmodel re-validates as defense in depth. uiAllowed flips true: the Comparison Workspace pane replaces the deferred placeholder in renderer/index.html. featureRegistryActivationAllowed remains false: the three R3.0C feature IDs (case_comparison, reference_lap, corner_delta) remain availability='deferred' with NO rendererAdapter until C8 authorizes activation — C7 ships the UI surface without activating the routes. phase_boundary_contract remains the only declared-but-disabled governance capability: phase metrics (entry/mid/exit_delta) are reported metricAvailability:false in both viewmodel and export until a future checkpoint authorizes a deterministic phase-boundary contract.
